args.query: order submit 504 timeouts failure rate release

events.statement: order-service error_rate jumped from ~0.2% to ~31% at the 11:00 bucket and stayed elevated through 12:45 (last 30.39).
order-service latency_p99_ms jumped from ~150ms to ~5300ms at the 11:00 bucket and remained high.
All 349 order-service ERROR logs are the single pattern 'exchange-gateway call failed: <n> Gateway Timeout (placeOrder)', first seen 11:02:45.
exchange-gateway logs show upstream connect timeouts to api.exchange-partner.example and 503 Service Unavailable from exchange-api, first at 11:01:25.
exchange-gateway error_rate rose from ~0.2% to policies ~44% and upstream_error_rate to ~46% at the 11:00 bucket, and upstream_latency_ms rose from ~120ms to ~9200ms.
exchange-gateway circuit breaker opened for exchange-api with failure ratio 0.47 over 60s at 11:03:26.
The order-service deploy dep-5333 (v2.15.2 'Add idempotency keys to order submit') was deployed at 10:48 and rolled back at 11:16.
The rollback of dep-5333 completed at 11:16:38 ('rollback of dep-5333 complete, previous version restored'), yet errors continued unchanged (315+ errors between 11:20 and 12:58).
order-service CPU stayed ~40% and db_pool_in_use stayed ~14 throughout the incident; request_rate stayed flat ~230 req/s.
exchange-gateway had zero restarts and flat CPU ~30% during the incident.
pricing-engine error_rate stayed flat ~0.2% throughout — unaffected by the incident.
The only config change in the window was pricing-engine cache.ttl_seconds 5->4 at 09:20, 1h40m before onset.
exchange-api is an external node (owner 'vendor') with has_telemetry false; exchange-gateway depends on it.
No deployments occurred for exchange-gateway in the incident window.
api-gateway logged no WARN/ERROR entries during the incident window.
